stage: Historical ES futures ITI signal generation; no order execution

input.selection: Point-in-time contracts; never substitute today's on-the-run assignment
input.join: Latest VX trade strictly earlier than each ES event; no invented VX default

month.rollover_rule: Front expiry strictly after value date, matching production NextRolloverDate = LastTradeDate

postgres.bootstrap: Clone all source schemas without source rows; production schema initializers and default policies run in the integration fixture

execution.architecture: Existing analytics Kestrel integration host, actor producer, durable command/event/projector path, completion-driven Daily to Weekly/Monthly hierarchy
execution.broker_and_cache: Fresh fixture-owned NATS/JetStream and Redis for each run
execution.raw_tick_adapter: Read-only Scylla export to retained, checksummed daily CSVs; every eligible tick is evaluated with the production calculator and state-changing Daily commands enter the durable actor pipeline
execution.excluded: Native/live feed, order execution, strategy workflow; no writes to source tick tables during replay
execution.limits: Cold start on October 1, without September warmup. Missing initial VX prices are counted skips; prior prices carry across sessions without an additional stale-price gate, matching current ITI ingress. Full realtime ingress actors and a virtual audit clock are not replayed. Business timestamps are historical; framework audit timestamps remain wall clock.
